subject: keyboard-focus-order
text: - An element is focusable if it holds a sub-document, or if it is not inert (by presence on itself or an ancestor element, `Node::is_inert`), is no disabled form control and either has `tabindex >= 0` or, with no tabindex, is an `<a>`/`<area>` with `href` or a `button`, `input`, `select`, `textarea`, `frame`, `iframe` or `summary` (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/element.rs:742-774) — `disabled` read by its presence on a form control alone (`ElementData::is_disabled`: `can_be_disabled()` and the attribute present), any value, bare, `"false"` or `"true"`, so a `<div disabled tabindex=0>` takes focus; the Tab walk (`focus_next_node` / `focus_prev_node`), autofocus (a disabled form control or an inert candidate skipped) and `DioxusDocument::unkeyed_actionable` read it (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/element.rs:516-520; packages/blitz-dom/src/node/element.rs:743; packages/blitz-dom/src/node/node.rs:563-580; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:889-930) — the presence reading ratified by the founder (2026-10-13, «По наличию (Рекомендую)», confirmed on the wrap's answer card on 2026-10-14 «Подтвердить (Рекомендую)», each by question dialog in the overseer session, relayed verbatim by the overseer as his chosen option label), its narrowing to form controls and the `inert` read ratified by the founder (2026-10-18); a known limit stands: HTML's focus fixup is not built, so a node that holds focus when it becomes inert keeps it until focus moves (tests/blitz-tests/tests/inert_subtree.rs:77-102; tests/blitz-tests/tests/inert_subtree.rs:153-363), its fix owned by a `.andromeda/residuals.md` line (target: next)

subject: keyboard-focus-order
text: - Tab moves focus to the next node and Shift+Tab to the previous, dispatching focus events (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/keyboard.rs:29-44); `focus_next_node` / `focus_prev_node` move focus to the next/previous focussable node (packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:1854-1867)

subject: keyboard-focus-order
text: - Cached focusability is recomputed when `tabindex`, `href` or `disabled` is set or removed (packages/blitz-dom/src/mutator.rs:350-359; packages/blitz-dom/src/mutator.rs:515-522); tests assert focusability follows `tabindex` set or cleared after creation (roving tabindex) (tests/blitz-tests/tests/focusability_updates.rs:1-6; tests/blitz-tests/tests/focusability_updates.rs:34-57)

subject: keyboard-focus-order
text: - `button`, `input`, `select` and `textarea` can be disabled, which toggles the `DISABLED`/`ENABLED` states (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/element.rs:479-486; packages/blitz-dom/src/node/element.rs:512-514; packages/blitz-dom/src/node/node.rs:828-850); setting `disabled` removes a button's focusability (tests/blitz-tests/tests/focusability_updates.rs:63-76)

subject: keyboard-focus-order
text: - Disabled-ness is keyed one way since 2026-10-13-stand-keyboard-harness: the `DISABLED`/`ENABLED` element state (hence `:disabled`) reads the attribute's PRESENCE, and the pointer-move gate, `ClickTarget::Disabled`, `handle_click`'s walk gate, the Enter and Space activation and focusability read `ElementData::is_disabled` — that presence on a `button`, `input`, `select` or `textarea` alone (ratified by the founder, 2026-10-18) — so `disabled="false"` and a bare `disabled=""` on a form control match `:disabled` and are not focusable, and a bare `disabled` set after creation takes its focusability away (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/element.rs:480-485; packages/blitz-dom/src/node/element.rs:516-520; packages/blitz-dom/src/node/element.rs:743; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:329; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:462; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:760; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/keyboard.rs:260; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/keyboard.rs:277; tests/blitz-tests/tests/focusability_updates.rs:59-62; tests/blitz-tests/tests/focusability_updates.rs:78-96; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:889-930) — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-13-stand-keyboard-harness/report.md; before it focusability parsed the value as a bool and both stayed focusable (as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-06-headless-stand/evidence/disabled-false-probe.txt)

subject: keyboard-focus-order
text: - Under the `autofocus` feature, the latest mounted focussable node whose `autofocus` attribute is present with any value but "false" — bare, empty or "true" — is focused on flush, and `autofocus="false"` is ignored (packages/blitz-dom/src/mutator.rs:1143-1155; packages/blitz-dom/src/mutator.rs:1045-1050; tests/blitz-tests/tests/autofocus_attribute.rs:27-50) — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-10-upstream-sync-agent-surfaces/report.md

subject: keyboard-focus-restoration
text: - Removing the focused node resets focus to the body (encoded as `None`) and runs blur side effects (packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:1034-1036; packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:1052-1071); removing a focused text input runs blur side-effects and disables IME (tests/blitz-tests/tests/interaction_state_teardown.rs:189-217)

subject: keyboard-focus-restoration
text: - Clicking a non-interactive area clears focus (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:998-1001)

subject: keyboard-focus-restoration
text: - A pointer click on a `button` (any type) or an `input` of type `submit`, `reset` or `button` focuses it through `generate_focus_events` / `set_focus_to`, then submits the form owner when it is a submit button, and ends the walk matched — since 2026-10-13-stand-keyboard-harness, in every document; before it a submit button submitted without breaking the walk and every other button fell through to the unmatched clear of focus, so an accepted click on one left no element focused (as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-10-scrolling-box-bounds-and-hit/report.md); a disabled form control still stops the walk first, a disabled ancestor `div` not (ratified by the founder, 2026-10-18), a click on a `select` focuses it through `generate_focus_events` / `set_focus_to`, clearing its typeahead and the document's text selection, a disabled select stopped by the walk's gate first so it neither focuses nor acts, while an option is not clicked (a driver `click` on one is refused `covered` — on the stand the flight booker's two options among them) (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:875-888; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_act_select.rs:177-203; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_act_select.rs:240-261), and a click on any other element is unchanged — a CRUD row or the list still clears focus; on the stand a click focuses each stand button and Tab continues from it, and after an accepted driver `click` on `fx-before` it reads `focused` and is the tree's focus, in both layout modes (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:938-950; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:1056-1073; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:850-877; the restated `stand_act_obstructed`) — ratified by the founder (2026-10-13, «Клик даёт фокус (Рекомендую)», each by question dialog in the overseer session, relayed verbatim by the overseer as his chosen option label) — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-13-stand-keyboard-harness/report.md

subject: keyboard-focus-restoration
text: - Two pointer clicks on one point within 500 ms and 2 px are a double click, read on the document's clock — on a harness-built document the harness's `VirtualClock`, so two driver `click`s on one point with no `advance` between them are a double click, selecting a word in a text input — while each still focuses its target as one click does (ratified by the founder, 2026-10-18) (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:393-403; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_virtual_clock.rs:117-133)

subject: keyboard-focus-restoration
text: - Activating the first `summary` of a `details` toggles it open and focuses the summary (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:848-874)

subject: keyboard-focus-restoration
text: - A `details` or `dialog` carrying `open` holds the `OPEN` element state — `ElementData::flush_open_state`, run at element construction and on every `open` write or removal through the mutator — so `:open` matches it, in every document; activating a `details`'s first `summary` (above) toggles `open` through the mutator and so flips `:open`; no test asserts `:open` (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/element.rs:488-489; packages/blitz-dom/src/node/element.rs:543-549; packages/blitz-dom/src/mutator.rs:372-375; packages/blitz-dom/src/mutator.rs:528-531; packages/blitz-dom/src/stylo.rs:510) — as measured at escher-0.3.0/chunks/2026-10-27-upstream-sync-engine-debts/report.md

subject: keyboard-focus-restoration

subject: keyboard-focus-restoration
text: - A click on a range input focuses it through `generate_focus_events` and changes no value, so a label's synthetic click focuses it without moving the value, while a main-button pointerdown, its arm after the `disabled` arm, sets the value from the hit's fraction of the content box, clamped to [0, 1], a content box of no width reading 0 — since 2026-10-13-range-input-interaction, in every document; before it no click focused or moved a range input (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:452-456; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:653-664; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:512-514; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:666-681; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:768-780) — ratified by the founder (2026-10-13, «Клик даёт фокус (Рекомендую)», confirmed on the wrap's answer card «Подтвердить (Рекомендую)», each by question dialog in the overseer session, relayed verbatim by the overseer as his chosen option label) — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-13-range-input-interaction/report.md

subject: keyboard-handling
text: - A focused `input type="range"` with no `disabled` attribute (read by presence) steps up on ArrowRight and ArrowUp, down on ArrowLeft and ArrowDown, goes to its minimum on Home and its maximum on End, and every other key does nothing — since 2026-10-13-range-input-interaction, in every document; its value is a current value held apart from the `value` attribute (`RangeInputData`), sanitized to `[min, max]` on the step grid, and each change marks the changed set and fires one `input` event, a move that changes nothing firing none (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/keyboard.rs:102-107; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/keyboard.rs:152-169; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/keyboard.rs:444-465) — ratified by the founder (2026-10-13, «Стрелки + Home/End (Рекомендую)», confirmed on the wrap's answer card «Подтвердить (Рекомендую)», each by question dialog in the overseer session, relayed verbatim by the overseer as his chosen option label) — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-13-range-input-interaction/report.md
